verdict.rationale: Floot's editor includes a preview with switchable device frames (Desktop, iPhone, Pixel, iPad, Responsive), and you can share a development preview separately from publishing, so a pre-publish preview clearly exists. The evidence does not explicitly say the preview is a live, clickable running app that updates as you build. It is also unclear whether the 'point at an element' feedback happens inside that preview. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the in-editor preview is fully interactive and updates live during building, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the preview experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: switch between Desktop, iPhone (393 × 852), Pixel (412 × 915), iPad (820 × 1180), and a resizable Responsive frame
It opens with no login, so it works in a phone browser or an in-app webview
